text:
sanjay: heads up — p95/p99 lines disappeared from the latency dashboard when org=acme is selected after this morning's canary (~10:18 UTC). CS raised CS-9987, customer seeing spikes but tails not rendered.

maria: can you drop the exact panel link and the panel query? :eyes:

sanjay: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/latency?org=acme panelId=42
sanjay: panel query is:
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
```

maria: quick thought — we shipped a label rename in the new collector (route -> svc_route) in v2.4.0. if the panel groups by `route` it will stop producing per-route series for tenants using the new collector. global org view might still show tails if mixed.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed: runtime v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0 @1719002100

jess: repro steps I ran:
1) run same promql against metrics API without org filter -> p95/p99 series present
2) run with `org="acme"` -> p95/p99 absent
3) inspect raw series labels -> new series have `svc_route` not `route`.

ops-bot: quick curl to metrics server that returns the matching series:
```
curl -G 'https://metrics.redwood.ai/api/v1/query' --data-urlencode 'query=histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_bucket[5m])) by (le, svc_route))'
```

maria: mitigation options: 1) patch dashboard panels to use svc_route where applicable (manual) 2) make collector emit both `route` and `svc_route` for a 24h compatibility window 3) rollback the collector rollout.

sanjay: customer wants immediate visibility — which option is quickest without risking more regressions?

jess: hotfix plan: add back-compat shim in collector to copy label `route` -> `svc_route` or vice versa. I can ship a canary-only hotfix in ~30m and then promote if green.

support_lead: told CS team ETA ~30m and created INC-5463. CS updated the customer that we're on it. :thumbsup:

maria: for postmortem action item — add a dashboard CI test that fails if panels reference labels that don't exist in the metrics schema; also require label-change runbook for collector rollouts.

ops-bot: incident INC-5463 created by support_lead

sanjay: thanks everyone — I'll keep CS updated. once hotfix is out I'll re-check panel and share a screenshot.
